# Skill title

Say in one or two sentences what the assistant should do when this skill is used.

## Steps

1. The first thing to do.
2. The next thing to do.

## Rules

- What must always be done.
- What must never be done.

## Output

Describe the result: its structure, format and length.

comment.text: Markdown template that fills the instructions of a new skill; the user replaces it. Keep every line break and the Markdown markers exactly (# and ## headings, numbered and dash list items); translate only the words.
